description.describe_ch: 統計計算為統計訓練的過程中必要的部份，它廣泛的觸及了統計的理論與應用。本課程將涵蓋在統計計算上的一些基本原理。本課程將會使學生學習建立統計分析所需的程式設計技巧，資料處理、數學演算及邏輯思考上的方法，並且介紹一些在統計計算上的問題及實例。
description.describe_eh: Statistical computing is an essential part of modern statistical training, as it touches on almost every aspect of statistical theory and practice. This course will help the students build the programming skills needed for analysis, introduce students to data manipulation, algorithms and algorithmic thinking and present some examples of computational problems in statistics. Various programming languages and packages will be used, including R and SAS.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
R is an integrated suite of software facilities for data manipulation, calculation and graphical display. Among other things it has
• an effective data handling and storage facility,
• a suite of operators for calculations on arrays, in particular matrices,
• a large, coherent, integrated collection of intermediate tools for data analysis,
• graphical facilities for data analysis and display either directly at the computer or on hard-copy, and
• a well developed, simple and effective programming language which includes conditionals, loops, user defined recursive functions and input and output facilities.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Academic misconduct refers to practices that a student or a researcher is aware of but deliberately and significantly deviates from the genreally accepted academic behavior, such as fabrication, falsification, plagiarism and any act of dishonesty in any forms. Depending on the research stage, research misconduct can be divided into five types:
1. inappropriate data collection
2. fabrication (falsification) of lab data
3. plagiarism
4. inappropriate authorship or designation
5. duplicate submission, publication, and application
Reference Link: https://ethics.moe.edu.tw/resource/englishguide/redirect/?pid=1&ft=odp
 
Penalties for academic misconduct can range from a grade of zero of the assignment(s)/assessment(s) to a penalty as severe as suspension for multiple dishonest acts reported.
